principles: Core progression recipes must use renewable/farmable materials because quality mastery requires repeated valid crafts.
Unique/boss-only materials are reserved for special one-off or prestige formulas, never mandatory repeated practice.
Failure consumes ingredients, so recipe burden must include expected failed attempts.
Later formulations increase source diversity and scarcity more than raw ingredient count.
Crafting output remains one unit before future yield/efficiency systems.

vitality_progression.notes: Preserves the current introductory blood recipe identity.
All ingredients are renewable; adds nourishment and controlled heat.
Uses a destructive-but-renewable fungal extraction as its principal scarcity gate.
Late renewable plant + monster resources. No unique/boss component.

pure_qi_progression.notes: Separates Qi recovery from the blood-root vitality loop.
Working name only; all ingredients already exist.
Working name only; stronger gate through destructive fungal extraction.
Preserves the existing Tempestad recipe identity.
